info.title: Baby care team integration contract
info.description: P0 frontend integration agreement dated 2026-09-20. B-07 1차 adds eventless normalization and atomic confirmation, including a StateObservation refetch path for B-09. Episode-linked outcomes remain a later slice. Internal training curator/export APIs retain the v2 scope and are not browser endpoints.

get.description: Primary foreground recovery path. Returns coalesced identifiers for all committed shared changes after since_revision through one atomic current_revision boundary. Empty changes means no change only when resync_required=false. Initial revision 0, retained-history gaps, future revisions, or more than 500 distinct resources return an empty list with resync_required=true. Poll every 5 seconds only while visible and immediately on return; this interval is not a 5-second screen guarantee. Realtime remains disabled until SEC30 and SEC31 are verified.

UserBearer.description: B validates signature, issuer, audience, expiry and current DB membership. A publishable key is not a user token.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID per logical mutation. Must equal client_request_id in JSON bodies. Reuse after an uncertain response.

Version.name: version
Version.description: Current resource version for destructive changes.

ReauthenticationProof.name: X-Reauthentication-Proof
ReauthenticationProof.description: Single-use 5-minute proof bound to this user, OTP-authenticated session, operation, and baby.

IssuedInvite.description: Plaintext token is returned only on initial creation. An idempotent replay returns invite_url=null and link_reissue_required=true; explicitly reissue to obtain a new link.

ReauthenticationChallenge.description: A challenge is valid for 10 minutes. Complete a fresh Supabase email OTP sign-in; token_refresh alone is never proof.

ReauthenticationProof.description: The 5-minute proof is bound to user, OTP-authenticated session, operation, and baby. It is consumed atomically with the protected mutation. Idempotent replay recovers the prior mutation result without consuming it again.

SessionRevocation.description: Local API and Storage access is blocked durably before provider refresh-session revocation. FAILED is not reported as logout success.

ChildDataVerification.description: OWNER role and email OTP do not establish legal-guardian status. Production child-data processing remains disabled until an approved verification method and policy are configured.

SetBabyConsent.description: Initial version is 0. Only OWNER can set baby-scoped consent. Revocation can start cleanup.

SetTrainingConsent.description: Only the authenticated contributor. After membership ends, revocation is allowed but new opt-in is not.

CreateEpisode.description: AUTO requires an active observation session. The server verifies origin against the environment; unknown file timing never implies current context.

Analysis.description: A stored FAILED or ABSTAIN resource is returned with HTTP 200 on successful retrieval. inference_executed means an actual audio model call, never a stub.

PatchCareEvent.description: Replace the confirmed structured event. Input with raw text must use a revision draft and confirm instead.

CreateAction.description: Exactly one of care_event_id and new_care_event is non-null. Both belong to the path episode baby. Only actual PERFORMED actions.

Evidence.description: Text offsets count Unicode code points: start inclusive, end exclusive. A matching source reference is mandatory for extracted assertions.

ConfirmCareEntry.description: LLM requires current successful run_id. RULE and MANUAL require null run_id. Validation and final writes are atomic. Confirmed means caregiver-reported, not a verified cause.

resource_type.description: Identifies the existing authorized FastAPI resource to refetch. DELETION never exposes a requester-private DeletionJob.

resource_id.description: Opaque identifier only. The change feed never contains resource bodies, caregiver text, audio URLs, or tokens.

version.description: Actual version of the changed resource after the mutation, including the tombstone version when deleted=true.

deleted.description: When true, remove this resource from the scoped cache. A later response with a lower version must not restore it.

current_revision.description: A complete high-water mark for this response. When resync_required=false, every committed shared change in (since_revision, current_revision] is represented after same-resource coalescing.

changes.description: At most one latest item per resource. One mutation may invalidate multiple resources, such as a CareEvent and the Baby whose public context_revision advanced. Ordering is not a client conflict-resolution rule; use resource version.

resync_required.description: If true, changes is empty and the client must perform a full authorized refetch. This covers initial revision 0, pruned history, a future revision, and more than 500 distinct changed resources.

Changes.description: Authorization-scoped invalidation feed. Save current_revision only after every required refetch or the documented full-resync flow succeeds.

Error403.description: Authenticated but insufficient role or consent.

Error404.description: Not found or not accessible, including another author private draft.

Error409.description: Version, state, duplicate-key payload, or active-operation conflict. Inspect code.

Error410.description: Expired/revoked invite or a deleted resource visible to its requester.

Error422.description: Request validation failed; always uses ApiError.

Error500.description: Unexpected failure; verify saved state before retry.

Error503.description: Model not ready or service temporarily unavailable.
